title: The manager page gets a browser of its own
notes: Reported by the user 2026-11-26: the manager page (the first tab, its own main session in ~/.dashboard) has no browser of its own; its session's browser commands land in new-crm's browser (another project's tabs and sign-ins). Find how a browser command picks its project when the asker is the manager's session or pane (browserActions in src/main/main.ts:217, projectPath/slotOf; MANAGER_SLOT in src/shared/manager/manager.ts; the session/pane id the command carries) and why it resolves to new-crm. Fix: the manager gets its own browser, with its own partition and sign-ins, shown on the manager page the way a project's is (Ctrl+Shift+B), and the manager's agents' browser commands use it. Keyboard-first and help-dialog rules apply (CLAUDE.md). Hand check in the app after a rebuild; say so in the report.
